description:
Rehearse filtered history creation in a throwaway clone using the ownership projection. Retain only site-owned docs history; exclude docs/blog, docs/CNAME, core-only and generated outputs and all .py/pyproject.toml/uv.lock/*.pem paths at every historical revision. Account for renames without importing unrelated content. Scan full filtered history for secrets and prohibited files. Do not publish a final archive before frozen S exists. Final re-filter through S, scan, tip-tree equality and archive-branch publication are explicitly re-homed to docs-mig-core-freeze.
Retain human authors including third-party contributors and original historical commit messages/trailers by default; apply identity/trailer checks to newly authored commits only. Strip actual secrets/session private material, not unrequested history rewriting or fabricated attribution. Reconcile license provenance using core LICENSE/MIT text scoped to imported docs (preserving rights, not relicensing).
Exact metadata rule: retain original historical human attribution and Co-Authored-By history; strip Claude-Session lines/agent session URLs as private runtime metadata from filtered branch. Apply no-trailers rule only to newly authored snapshot commits. Scanner placeholder rules may only match exact patterns from deploy/gates/privacy.ts; no blanket exceptions.
